title: SASSA Grant Eligibility Guide
description: Find out which SASSA grant you qualify for based on your personal circumstances. Situation-based guides for unemployed, students, seniors, disabled, and more.

seo.metaTitle: Am I Eligible? — SASSA Grant Eligibility Guide
seo.metaDescription: Not sure which SASSA grant you qualify for? Select your situation: unemployed, student, over 60, disabled, caregiver, UIF recipient, or self-employed. Find matching grants with full eligibility criteria.

contentBlocks.text: Different SASSA grants have different eligibility requirements. Find the guide that matches your personal circumstances to see which grant you may qualify for. Our situation-based guides cover the most common scenarios.

faqs.question: What is the income limit for SASSA grants?
faqs.answer: For most grants, single applicants must earn below R112,200 per year. For the SRD R370 grant, your monthly bank inflows must stay under R624.

faqs.question: Can I get a grant if I have a part-time job?
faqs.answer: You may still qualify if your earnings fall below the means test threshold. Casual or gig economy income under R624/month generally won't disqualify you.

faqs.question: Does UIF or NSFAS affect my eligibility?
faqs.answer: Yes. Active UIF payments above R624/month or any NSFAS funding will disqualify you from the SRD R370 grant. We have specific guides for both scenarios.

faqs.question: What if my situation changes after I'm approved?
faqs.answer: You must report changes in income, employment, or household composition to SASSA. Failure to do so can result in overpayment recovery or cancellation.
